facts.value: UL’s Professional Master of Education programme empowers you to deliver learning that makes a real impact.
research skills, using new technology, and delivering the right learning for everyone.

Business (Accounting, Business, Economics), Languages (French, German, Irish, Japanese, Spanish, English as a Second Language (ESL)), Mathematics, Music, Physical Education, Science (Agricultural Science, Biology, Chemistry, Physics), Technological Education (Engineering, Technology, Construction Studies, Design and Communication Graphics)
Students are encouraged to specialise in two subject areas where their Level 8 qualifications allow.
Those studying on the Languages pathway with credits in only one language must take English as a Second Language (ESL). ESL is not available with a non-language discipline.
Students studying on the Technological Education pathways must have the required credits in Design and Communication Graphics (DCG) plus one other subject.
This programme includes in-person teaching placements to ensure you are ready to start teaching as soon as you are qualified.
